***Exercise 1. Consider an AR(2) model defined by: Yt = ϕ1Yt−1 + ϕ2Yt−2 + εt***

**2. Write an R function that computes the theoretical autocovariances γ(0), γ(1), and γ(2) using your derived formulas.**

```{r}

autocovariance_0 <- function(sigma, phi1, phi2) { 
  var <- sigma^2
  
  gam0 <- (var*(1-phi2))/(1-phi2-((phi1^2)*(1+phi2))-(phi2^2)+(phi2^3))
  
  gam0

}

```

```{r}

autocovariance_1 <- function(sigma, phi1, phi2) {

  gam0 <- autocovariance_0(sigma, phi1, phi2)

  gam1 <- (phi1 / (1 - phi2)) * gam0

  gam1
}

```


```{r}
autocovariance_2 <- function(sigma, phi1, phi2) { 
  
  gam0 <- autocovariance_0(sigma, phi1, phi2)
  gam2 <- ((phi1^2)/(1-phi2))*gam0 + phi2*gam0
  
  gam2

}


```

**3. Using the following parameters: ϕ1 = 0.4, ϕ2 = 0.2, σ= 5.**

(a) Generate M = 1000 time series of length n= 1000 using arima.sim().
(b) For each simulated series, compute the empirical autocovariances for lags 0, 1, and 2.
(c) Create side-by-side boxplots comparing the empirical distributions to the theoretical values of the autocovariances for lag h= {0,1,2}.

```{r}

# Number of simulations and observations
M <- 1000
n <- 1000

set.seed(123)

sim <- replicate(
  M,
  arima.sim(
    model = list(ar = c(0.4, 0.2)),
    n = n,
    sd = 5
    )
)

matplot(
  sim[, 1],
  type = "l",
  lty = 1,
  xlab = "Time",
  ylab = "Y",
  main = "1 Simulated AR(2) Time Series"
)

```

```{r}

# Calculate empirical autocovariances for each simulation
empirical_autocov <- sapply(1:M, function(i) {

  as.numeric(acf(
    sim[, i],
    lag.max = 2,
    type = "covariance",
    plot = FALSE
  )$acf)

})

# Name the rows
rownames(empirical_autocov) <- c("Lag 0", "Lag 1", "Lag 2")

dim(empirical_autocov)

# Calculate the average empoirical autocovariances:
rowMeans(empirical_autocov)

```

```{r}

# Theoretical autocovariances:

autocovariance_0(5,0.4,0.2)
autocovariance_1(5,0.4,0.2)
autocovariance_2(5,0.4,0.2)
```

```{r}

# Boxplot

boxplot(
  t(empirical_autocov),
  names = c("Lag 0", "Lag 1", "Lag 2"),
  main = "Empirical Autocovariances",
  xlab = "Lag",
  ylab = "Autocovariance"
)

abline(
  h = c(
    autocovariance_0(sigma, phi1, phi2),
    autocovariance_1(sigma, phi1, phi2),
    autocovariance_2(sigma, phi1, phi2)
  ),
  col = "red",
  lty = 2
)
legend("topright",
       legend='Theoretical autocovariances',
       col='red', lty=2, lwd=1, bty="n")
```
